bead.title: Replace in-memory secondary indexes with axon-esf typed keys
bead.description: Replace ADR-010 raw length-prefixed byte index key encoding in crates/pqueue-projection with axon_esf typed index key helpers from axon-esf v0.3.2. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs, crates/pqueue/tests/secondary_indexes.rs, pqueue-core domain usage as needed. Remove or bypass encode_index_key/encode_index_lookup_key raw byte semantics for typed queues. Delegate missing field, null, datetime, float, boolean, compound, and leftmost-prefix semantics to axon-esf; sparse missing-field behavior remains unless axon-esf explicitly errors. Preserve unique conflict atomicity for push/update_fields/replace_pending and index removal on purge. Out-of-scope: relational SQL parity.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue secondary_indexes -- --nocapture passes; tests cover integer numeric equality/order-vs-lexical regression, boolean, datetime, compound key, missing-field sparse behavior, unique conflicts, update_fields move, replace_pending move, and purge removal; rg 'len\)|to_be_bytes\(\).*index|ADR-010.*bytes|encode_index_key' crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs shows no production raw secondary-index encoder remains.
